13 Tiger Range Countries adopted St. Petersburg Declaration.
Global Tiger Day is observed annually on 29 July by IUCN.
Tiger Reserve was set up in 1973 as Jim Corbett National Park (Uttarakhand).
TX2 was chosen as initiative's motto, representing goal of doubling global tiger population by 2022.
13 Tiger Range Countries adopted St. Petersburg Declaration.
Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, China, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, Russia, Thailand, and Vietnam
Currently, there are 58 Tiger Reserves in India.
Madhya Pradesh leads with 9 Reserves, followed by Maharashtra and Karnataka.
Tiger Reserves with Highest Tiger Abundance: Corbett (260), Bandipur (150).
Nagarjunsagar Srisailam (Andhra Pradesh and Talengana) is Largest Tiger Reserve in India
Project Tiger: Established in 1973 to support Preservation of Tigers in India.
